extracted.name: Pumpkin Bundt Cake
extracted.description: A dense cake that lightly sweet with a robust crust. The spices are subtle so they compliment the pumpkin and not overpower it.
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 350°F, and grease and flour a standard bundt pan
Combine the sugar, oil and eggs in a mixer and mix on medium while you prepare the other ingredients
Combine the dry ingredients in a bowl and whisk to combine
Add the pumpkin and vanilla to the wet ingredients and continue to mix
Add the dry ingredient and mix until smooth
Pour the batter into the prepared bundt pan and bake for 1 hour and 20 minutes, rotating the cake half way through.
Cool the cake in the bundt pan until only warm to the touch. Turn out onto a wire rack and cool the remainder.
Dust with powdered sugar and serve.
